title: Expert Agent Builder, Forward Deployed Engineering
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Sales    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        About Salesforce:   We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.     About the Role   We are seeking a highly accomplished technologist to join our Forward Deployed Engineering Team as an Expert Agent Builder. This role represents the pinnacle of AI technical expertise, focusing on architecting, designing, and building the most complex and sophisticated agentic systems to solve our customers' most difficult challenges. You will be the technical conscience and thought leader, translating ambiguous customer needs into concrete, executable AI solutions.    You will drive transformative AI solutions by tackling the technical frontier of intelligent automation. You will build first of their kind best in class experiences for the world’s biggest brands - including headless agent automations, dynamic AI driven custom user interfaces, and complex multi-agent solutions.  This demands unparalleled software development mastery, deep software architecture skills, and a relentless focus on implementing engineering best practices to deliver maximum tangible value in dynamic, real-world enterprise environments. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond.     Your Impact    Define Agentic Architecture:  Design, architect, and hands-on develop the most difficult and bespoke agentic AI solutions that leverage the full power of the Agentforce platform and integrate with complex enterprise systems to solve critical customer challenges.     Build and Deploy Agent Systems:  Apply extensive hands-on experience to integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and expertly utilize agent-building and orchestration frameworks (e.g., Agentforce, LangChain, LlamaIndex) to implement and deploy complex agent-based solutions.     Lead Engineering Best Practices:  Master our development process, culture, and code base, then define, improve, and enforce engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, and security across all deployed agentic solutions.     Drive Platform Customization:  Utilize significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform to perform advanced configuration, customization, and complex development necessary to support and integrate agentic solutions.     Develop Data & Integration Solutions:  Design strategic data models and build efficient processing pipelines to ensure data is ready, optimized, and secure for advanced AI applications.     Proactively Remove Technical Blockers:  Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, serving as the ultimate go-to expert for advanced agent orchestration and intricate data integration issues.     Drive Agentforce Innovation:  Become the foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, leading the development of custom intelligent agents and influencing future product enhancements based on deep field insights.     Undertake Continuous Learning:  Maintain expertise in the latest AI advancements, both within the company and the wider industry, and proactively seek opportunities to integrate this knowledge for product and process innovation.         Required Qualifications     8+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions. Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.      Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Apex, JavaScript, Python). Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and databases.      Experience building applications with modern web component frameworks like React, Angular, or LWC.      Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including:      Integrating LLMs and applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).      Developing custom agentic frameworks and systems.      Deep understanding of machine learning and natural language processing.      Expertise in prompt engineering, advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) strategies, and defining/automating rigorous evaluation and testing frameworks for LLM outputs and agentic workflows.          Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).      Proven experience in automated testing, including unit and functional testing, and the ability to develop test strategies and design automation frameworks.      Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with people from various backgrounds and levels of expertise.      Track record of innovation and problem solving to find creative technical solutions to new and unforeseen business problems.      Ability to travel 30% of the time, as needed to customer sites.         Preferred Qualifications     Significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customization, and complex development.      Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or libraries.      Advanced Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Platform Developer II, Application Architect, System Architect).      Expert-level experience with Apex, Javascript, and/or Python coding languages in a professional setting.      Experience with voice systems preferably in an agentic setting, but including text-to-speech and speech-to-text APIs.      Appreciation for high quality user experiences that go beyond accomplishing the bare minimum.              Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Senior Software Engineer - Context and Semantics (AI)
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  The Data Cloud organization is at the forefront of Workday’s next major wave of innovation, driven by a bold mandate to build the industry’s first true Platform for Agents. We are a high-energy, ambitious team that balances Workday's deep foundational expertise with fresh, forward-thinking perspectives to accelerate our pace of delivery and unlock massive new commercial value. By leveraging Workday’s unique business context, trusted data, and identity guardrails, we are building the critical engine that will power the future of AI and agentic workflows across the enterprise.  Within this organization, the Context and Semantics Engineering team acts as the brain trust responsible for making our AI "enterprise-aware." We build the semantic layers, knowledge graphs, query federation engines, and dynamic context systems that ground generative AI in real-world HR and Finance data. By bridging the gap between raw enterprise data and large language models (LLMs), our team ensures that Workday’s autonomous agents can reason accurately, securely, and with deep contextual awareness at a global scale.    About the Role     As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Context and Semantics, you will be a lead builder and technical anchor for the infrastructure powering Workday’s AI Agents. You will be hands-on in designing, coding, and scaling the backend systems that connect our foundational models to highly complex enterprise data.    Your day-to-day will sit at the intersection of distributed data engineering and applied AI. You will build advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, implement vector search infrastructure, and develop query federation layers (e.g., Trino/LDQ) that seamlessly route LLM data requests across our transactional (OMS) and analytical (Data Lake) stores. We are looking for a highly autonomous, product-minded engineer who thrives in ambiguity, writes exceptionally clean code, and is passionate about solving the unique latency, cost, and security constraints of enterprise AI.     Responsibilities:      System Design & Coding:  Architect, build, and deploy robust backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that form the core semantic and context layer for Workday’s AI Agents.     AI & RAG Infrastructure:  Design and optimize enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including embedding generation, intelligent chunking strategies, and vector database integration (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Elasticsearch).     Query Federation & Semantic Routing:  Build and scale distributed query execution layers (leveraging technologies like Trino) to seamlessly fetch and translate context across transactional systems and data lakes.     LLM Orchestration:  Develop dynamic context and memory management workflows using modern AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LlamaIndex, LangChain, GraphRAG) to enable complex, multi-turn agentic reasoning.     Security & Guardrails:  Embed rigorous data privacy, tenant isolation, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) directly into the retrieval and context layers to ensure governed AI execution.     Performance & Scale:  Optimize system architectures for low-latency retrieval and high-throughput LLM interactions, tackling constraints around token management and context-window efficiency.     Technical Leadership:  Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead code and design reviews, and establish engineering best practices for this new 0-to-1 product area.       About You      Basic Qualifications:     8+ years of professional software engineering experience focusing on backend architecture, data engineering, or distributed systems.    5+ years of strong hands-on programming expertise in Java, Python, Scala, or Go.    1+ years of dedicated experience building production-grade LLM applications, RAG pipelines, Vector Search systems, or Knowledge Graphs.       Other Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical field.    Experience building or optimizing distributed SQL query engines (e.g., Trino, Presto, Spark) and bridging operational and analytical data stores.    Deep understanding of modern AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) and embedding models.    Proven ability to architect scalable, high-performance REST/gRPC APIs and microservices.    Experience handling sensitive, highly regulated data with a strong understanding of enterprise security boundaries and data governance.    Thrives in Ambiguity: A highly autonomous builder capable of taking open-ended AI product goals and breaking them down into concrete, scalable engineering realities.    Experience with the Workday platform or enterprise SaaS architectures is a strong plus.      Workday Pay Transparency Statement      The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below.  Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please   click here  .      Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton    Primary Location Base Pay Range:  $190,100 USD - $285,100 USD    Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $160,100 USD - $285,100 USD    Our Approach to Flexible Work      With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply   spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field   with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
